summary: Full E2E verification of the 4 meal-module enhancements: (A) Stock-take Print, (B) Variance Report, (C) Adjustment Audit, (D) Ledger granularity. Backend curl-smoke of /meals/stock-take/report + /meals/items/{id}/ledger?granularity=week|month|day all return correct shapes. Frontend Playwright end-to-end: logged in as admin, opened Purchases & Issues -> Stock Take tab, verified default 'Count sheet' view + view toggle testids + hidden print region (216k HTML chars) + Print sheet button invokes window.print(). Created a stock-take on TODAY (2026-09-12) for item Chicken (system 0.0, physical 2.0, +2.0 variance), got success toast '1 counted · 0 losses · 1 extra'. Switched to 'Variance & audit' view: variance-stats card set rendered (Loss ₹0, Extra ₹316.44, Net +₹316.44, Counts 1, Items 1), variance-row-<chicken-id> shows Chicken/Protein/—/+2.0/+2.0/₹316.44/1, audit-row-0 shows 'Chicken +2.0 kg · Counted 2.0 vs system 0.0 · Sat 12/09/26 · Campus Administrator · 12 Sept, 17:26'. 90d preset changed variance-start to 2026-06-15 and refetched. Ledger drawer: dbl-clicked entry-item-name-<chicken-id> from Daily Entry (after expanding Protein category), drawer opened; ledger-granularity toggle has all 3 buttons; Weekly is DEFAULT (bg-emerald-600 class); switching Monthly showed header 'Period' + row 'Jun 2026'; switching Daily showed header 'Date' + row 'Wed 17/06/26'; stock-take cell for 2026-09-12 renders '+2.0' with title tooltip 'Counted 2.0 vs system 0.0 · by Campus Administrator · on Sat 12/09/26'. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: StockVarianceReport.jsx uses timeZone hard-coded 'Asia/Kolkata' for the audit-row `stamp` timestamp — acceptable for this deployment but should ultimately follow the same tenant-timezone hook as the rest of the app.

MealStockTakeTab.jsx `handlePrint` adds a body class ('stocktake-print-active') then calls window.print() but the `afterprint` cleanup listener may leak across multiple prints if the user cancels before the event fires (rare). Consider wrapping with a small setTimeout fallback to always remove the class.

Backend /meals/stock-take/report has no pagination; a range spanning 5000+ adjustment docs would be truncated by the hard-coded `to_list(5000)` cap. Fine for the current campus scale but flag for future scaling.

MealEntryTab category rows still require a mouse-position click to expand (Playwright's simple .click() on the [data-testid=entry-cat-header-*] <tr> doesn't fire the onClick — same testing-harness quirk noted in iter_70). Consider adding the onClick to a nested <button> for testability.
test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 (Admin sign in with email toggle)
seed_data_creation: Created 1 stock-take adjustment (item Chicken, +2.0 kg, 2026-09-12) for verification. Cleaned up afterward via `db.meal_adjustments.delete_many({})`; collection is now EMPTY as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: meal_adjustments collection was cleaned to 0 rows post-test. Login pattern: click 'Admin sign in with email' toggle first (it's a collapsible), then get_by_role('button', name='Sign in', exact=True). After login the user lands on '/' (Check In/Out), not '/admin'. To open the ledger drawer via UI: (1) go to /admin/meals-report?tab=entry, (2) click text 'Protein' (or the desired category) to expand — the entry-cat-header-<key> tr onClick does not fire via plain Playwright .click() but IS triggered by page.mouse.click(x,y) at the bounding-box coordinates or page.get_by_text('Protein').click(force=True); (3) then dblclick the entry-item-name-<id>. All 4 acceptance clauses pass.
